implementation: Apple Secure Key Store CoreCrypto Module Firmware (vng_ltc)
description: Cryptographic library offering various cryptographic mechanisms to Apple frameworks in the Secure Enclave Processor environment. The following cipher implementation is covered: Generic C non-optimized block mode and compound ciphers with ARM VNG AES / hash assembler implementation.
